scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @mona/shared && npm run build -w @mona/minecraft-core && npm run build -w @mona/build-core && npm run build -w @mona/cit-core && npm run build -w @mona/pixel-core
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n API,DESKTOP -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @mona/build-worker && npm run start -w @mona/build-worker
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @mona/api && npm run build -w @mona/build-worker && npm run build -w @mona/desktop
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @mona/shared && npm run test -w @mona/minecraft-core && npm run test -w @mona/build-core && npm run test -w @mona/cit-core && npm run test -w @mona/pixel-core && npm run test -w @mona/api && npm run test -w @mona/build-worker && npm run test -w @mona/desktop
